Changed to open G# for Hilary du Pré by Mr Morley, which could be easily reversed. The flute was finished on the 13th June 1906 and bought by Daniel S Wood who was principal flute of the London Symphony Orchestra, had been since its inception in 1904, and would continue there until shortly before his death aged 55 in November 1927. The non-cocuswood copies are nowhere near as good.’  When I was presented with the beautiful Schumacher / Rudall Carte flute I knew I would never need another one. The sound and colour range seemed endless, so exploration was endless too. Jackie and I had great fun playing together and with Mum who found trios for us. (Mum was a superb pianist so we were never short of an accompanist.) Schumacher was the only flute maker at Rudall Carte who was allowed, by the company, to have all the necessary equipment for his craft at his own home. His flutes are the most sought after.'
